rule: transaction_id is unique
transaction_date is populated
amount is greater than zero
dated transactions fall inside the governed 2020-2023 reporting window
derived year and month agree with transaction_date
account_id appears once in the account master
every account has an opening_date
account_balance is not negative
closed accounts carry a zero balance
every customer holds at least one account (monitored)
each customer has a single customer_type
every loan links to an account in the account master
loan customer matches the account owner
loan start_date is populated
estimated_end_date is after start_date
loan starts on or after the account opening date
no active or overdue loans sit on closed accounts
active loans are not past their estimated end date at 2023-12-31
loan identifiers use the same numeric type as the account master
interest_rate is within the approved 1%-25% range
